exposure: placental metabolomics (lipids, amino acids, androgens, estrogens)
outcome: impaired production of estrone and estriol
aberrant hydroxylation and methylation of estradiol
cohort: Human placentas from patients with severe preeclampsia and normal pregnancies were analyzed.
finding: The study identified dysregulated steroid hormone biosynthesis in preeclampsia placentas, characterized by an altered cortisol-to-cortisone ratio, testosterone accumulation, decreased testosterone downstream metabolites, impaired estrone and estriol production, and aberrant estradiol modification.
